# Hive:Magnus

> Full-stack agent management on your own infrastructure: Hive for suite installation and recovery; HiveXUI for the single browser UI; Oathweave for identity; Emberpath for model routing; HiveMem for memory; HiveSkills for skills distribution; Magnus for Linux fleet operations; Embermend for reviewed remediation and verification; Ardent for durable agent tasks; Ardent Project Studio for team projects of Ardent agents; Cindertrace for security investigations, cases, and evidence; ChatterMost for conversation; Emberfold for context continuity.

The products keep their own repositories and stores. Embermend requires compatible Magnus; other integrations are optional and require configuration. In a Hive installation, HiveXUI is the browser UI for every installed product, with sections only for those products. Ardent has its own repository, can be managed by Magnus, and bundles the Emberfold library; a separate Emberfold HTTP service is not required. Ardent Project Studio is an optional suite product that needs Magnus with an Ardent agent, HiveMem and Oathweave. Inference services and model storage remain external to Hive. This website publishes documentation and sample UI captures, not a hosted agent service or installation endpoint. The products use Apache-2.0. Hive installs only from a signed release. Its launcher accepts `--release latest` or an exact version and runs the matching tagged controller. The latest published suite release is at https://github.com/ChefTaco/hive/releases/latest; the suite installation guide reviews Hive {{hm.suite}}. Individual product guides identify their own reviewed versions.

Guides include prerequisites, documented commands, expected results, and the public source revision reviewed. Follow the linked current repository documentation for upgrades and configuration changes. Before editing a repository, read its AGENTS.md.

## Start here

- [Site overview](https://hivemagnus.com/index.md): What the suite is good for, the two ways to deploy it (operators run the whole suite with Hive; developers use individual products, npm packages and SDKs), project selection, optional connections, and documentation links in Markdown.
- [Compatibility matrix](https://hivemagnus.com/compatibility.md): Generated from the signed release manifests: the product versions and image digests every published Hive suite release pins, the Ardent its Magnus host agent stages, which upgrades need `--allow-migrations`, and tags never to install.
- [Hive guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/hive.md): Install the latest published suite or Hive {{hm.suite}} with hive.sh and guided local setup, initial sign-in on Oathweave's page in the browser (passkey and MFA supported; from 3.15.1 every re-authentication too, and Emberpath's password relay is retired), guided administrator product access (`hive.sh admin-access setup`), the setup checklist, upgrades that need `--allow-migrations` (every upgrade from a release before 3.15.0, and with a suite-managed Magnus every upgrade from before 3.15.2), upgrading the Magnus host agents before the suite, Emberpath client keys for alias agents (3.15.2), agent directories that removal deletes only when the installer created them (3.15.3), the browser sign-in settings `post-upgrade` adds (`hive.sh console-clients check`), ChatterMost retention enforcement, backup and rehearsal retention with an optional daily prune, native profile backup for the installer-owned Magnus agent, Magnus host agents, a first Ardent assistant (`hive.sh ardent setup`, which from 3.15.3 checks the node's enrollment first, and `--retry-install`) and the agent dependency report, Cindertrace collectors and adding Cindertrace or the managed collector to an existing installation (`hive.sh add`), the mandatory Hive Registry, its inventory of what each host runs and its service capabilities, external inference, and existing installations.
- [HiveXUI guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/hivexui.md): The single browser UI ({{hm.version:hivexui}} in Hive {{hm.suite}}), what each section covers, sign-in and re-authentication through Oathweave with passkeys, Emberpath keys in New Agent, Set Emberpath key and Create agent from definition (0.15.0), the Installed software page, Studio recovery, lineage and workflows, resumable verified downloads in Deliverable Review, Agent 360 executions, Cindertrace local mode and recovery sign-in, the read-only node software card, and building it.
- [Magnus guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/magnus.md): Run the fleet manager through Hive or on its own; Magnus 3.5.1 (Ardent 3.6.0), 3.5.0 (Emberpath client keys for New Agent and definition installs, Set Emberpath key, one fast migration), 3.4.1 (hardening: agents before the server, restricted file writes, literal command arguments, HTTPS `IAM_CORE_URL`, Ardent 3.5.1 with the `Bearer` management token), 3.3.6 (`fast-xml-parser` security fix in the node agent), 3.3.5 (Ardent 3.2.1), 3.3.4 (agent-definition installs work, one additive migration), 3.3.1 to 3.3.3 (Emberpath checked at its model API, task streams through the console, native snapshots of Ardent 3.2.0 profiles), 3.3.0 (Ardent 3.2.0 recovery, lineage and artifact transfer v2 through management, portable agent definitions, the agent dependency report, pinned HiveSkills releases), 3.2.1 (production-only shrinkwraps), 3.2.0 (shipped `npm-shrinkwrap.json` and the ADMIN installation report), 3.1.6 (upgrade-request security patch), 3.1.5 (`effect` 3.22.1 in the server image), 3.1.4 (`ws` 8.23.0 security patch), 3.1.3 (Ardent 3.1.4 pin), 3.1.2 (maintenance fixes), 3.1.1 (verified quick diagnostics) and 3.1.0 (the agent's `native-snapshot` for managed Ardent profiles, read-only software status), 3.0.1 node keys only, one-time token enrollment, the upgrade from 2.10.2 with agents by way of 2.10.3, key rotation, revoke and reset, two-ADMIN scheduler-source settlement, retiring the shared secrets, rollback, and the optional web terminal gateway.
- [Ardent guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/ardent.md): Install the headless agent runtime from npm with bundled Emberfold, connect a model, run the gateway, or let Magnus install and manage it on fleet hosts, where `hive.sh ardent setup` creates a first assistant; 3.3.0 to 3.6.0 journal status, backup and prune (from 3.6.0 by profile size, for finished peer sessions and with `--vacuum`), the `not_ready` readiness word and the `Bearer`-only management token, 3.2.0 execution recovery, lineage, artifact transfer v2, parallel read tools, one retry policy, chat catch-up and the `@hivemagnus/ardent-client` remote client, which from 3.2.1 reaches Magnus through a Hive console with `apiBase`.
- [Ardent Project Studio guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/ardent-studio.md): Team assignment, the conversation room and deliverable review for Ardent agents, as the Studio section of HiveXUI; 0.8 Emberpath client keys for alias agents, 0.7 project membership, purge and backup, 0.5 workflows, recovery decisions, lineage, resumable imports with renditions, agent definitions from templates, and its one-way migrations.
- [Cindertrace guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/cindertrace.md): Security investigations in HiveXUI or standalone with HiveXUI in local mode (0.8.0 removed the standalone console), optional sources and integrations, optional TOTP and extra local accounts, its `audit.v1` export, the dedicated upgrade runbook and the 0.7.x to 0.8.0 move, and the isolated three-stage investigation lab.
- [ChatterMost guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/chattermost.md): Verify and install the versioned Compose distribution, release {{hm.version:chattermost}}, upgrade through its stepping stones (retention limits are enforced from 0.8.0), and connect an agent.
- [Emberfold guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/emberfold.md): Run a synthetic CLI dry run or use the TypeScript library; optional HTTP and Hermes interfaces.
- [Emberpath guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/emberpath.md): OpenAI-compatible model gateway with external providers, routing, quotas and traces, sign-in and step-up through Oathweave in the browser with the password relay retired (2.10.0), step-up only before a change, identity writes included (2.11.0), client keys for agents, 2.6.0 execution-linked traces and retry backoff, and its `emberpath` memory principal.
- [Oathweave guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/oathweave.md): Identity, authentication, authorization, browser sign-in with passkeys and MFA, re-authentication with `prompt=login` and `max_age`, and service identities.
- [HiveMem guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/hivemem.md): Memory storage, retrieval, sessions, graph evidence, consolidation and workspaces, idempotency keys and the search rate limit, and moving an agent's data with `rename-agent`.
- [HiveSkills guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/hiveskills.md): Skills registry, immutable archives, channels, assignments, distribution, 1.9.0 pinned releases, signed releases and request limits from 1.10.0. Not the Hive Registry.
- [Embermend guide](https://hivemagnus.com/guides/embermend.md): Optional Magnus-dependent remediation in the signed suite, scoped assessment, recommendation decisions, independent verification and approved local or network inference. Production mutation policies start disabled.

## Optional

- [All guides in one file](https://hivemagnus.com/llms-full.txt): The site overview and every product guide concatenated, each preceded by its URL, for agents that want everything in one request.

## Related projects

These public projects are not products of a Hive installation and have no guide on this site; follow their own repositories.

- [HiveCommon](https://github.com/ChefTaco/HiveCommon): `@hivemagnus/hive-common` 0.10.0, the shared server kit the suite products use: one Oathweave token verifier, one error envelope, health, request IDs and trace context, a Hive Registry client, safe logging and HiveEvents. A library, not an installed product.
- [canvas-word](https://github.com/ChefTaco/canvas-word): a canvas-based Word document engine (`@hivemagnus/canvas-word-engine` 2.0.0, browser) and a headless DOCX codec (`@hivemagnus/canvas-word-codec` 1.2.0, Node.js), maintained MIT forks of canvas-editor projects.
- [Proser](https://github.com/HiveMagnus/proser): a self-hosted writing studio for long-form fiction (release 1.2.1), installed with its own Docker Compose files; draft and revise manuscripts, keep a story bible and export DOCX and EPUB. Writers with an Oathweave account sign in through Oathweave in the browser (OpenID Connect, with passkeys and MFA at Oathweave); 1.2.1 retired its Oathweave password relay. Local and GitHub accounts are unchanged.
